manifest_row.title: Business group wants to meet Duterte on Paris climate deal

screening.main_topic: A Philippine business group seeks a meeting with President Duterte to discuss the Paris climate agreement and its implications for industry.
screening.climate_relevance: The report focuses on debate over the Paris Agreement, the Philippines’ emissions pledge and ratification, perceived burdens on developing countries, and energy needs including baseload power.
screening.reason: Climate policy and the Paris Agreement are the article’s central subject, including both support for a balanced discussion and the business group’s opposition to the agreement.
